author_room.name: Layer E Author Room

agents.claim: The story is not a list of chores; it is a longing for the small life that becomes romantic because it is shared.
agents.objection: If the art becomes object-only still life, the text carries everything.
agents.recommendation: Make every slide a visible action with hands, posture, object movement, and a partner response.

agents.claim: The supplied text can stay exact for this draft while the expression becomes original through A Story blocking, identity continuity, and camera variation.
agents.objection: A moody screenshot redraw would be derivative and less ownable.
agents.recommendation: Use mostly POV, back, side, and cropped frames with a distinct outfit per slide.

author_room.summary: The route passes because the ordinary-life wish list is translated into staged behavior rather than copied photographic scenes.
debate_records: Preserve exact copy in the draft package.
Reject screenshot recreation and quote-card design.
Use the relationship behavior to carry each line without relying on visible faces.

exploration_routes.name: Same Text, New Camera Life
exploration_routes.story_lens: Doing life together means choosing repeated ordinary rituals with the same person.
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: A cold viewer recognizes the desire to be loved through coffee, lists, markets, dishes, kitchen dancing, and laundry chaos.
exploration_routes.emotional_obstacle: The reference text is gentle but can become generic unless the visual scenes prove a particular shared life.
exploration_routes.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu remains expressive through hair silhouette, hands, jewelry, posture, and playful reactions even when her face is cropped or hidden.
exploration_routes.zuv_active_role: Zuv brews, writes, wanders, dries, leads/receives the dance, and tosses the sock back instead of being a passive silhouette.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: Each slide has a physical object in motion: mug, pen, tote, dish towel, clasped hand, sock, and shared doorway/path.
exploration_routes.emotional_reversal: The line starts as a poetic wish and becomes credible because the art shows action already happening.
exploration_routes.payoff: The final laundry beat keeps the romance human and playful instead of polished.
exploration_routes.distribution_reason: Viewers can send it as a soft exact-list confession to their partner.

stage_scene_gate.action: Every slide has one visible ordinary-life action.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: Every action includes a partner response, touch, posture shift, or visible participation.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Attention is aimed at the shared object, partner, or path.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: Hands pour, write, carry, wash, dry, dance, and toss.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: Upper negative space and cropped body language create quiet intimacy.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: The viewer understands the relationship beat without needing the source photograph.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: The soft domestic dream turns playful on the sock/laundry slide.

rejected_routes.name: Moody Screenshot Redraw
rejected_routes.emotional_obstacle: The art would be too close to the source account.
rejected_routes.proof_engine: Borrowed mood instead of new staged behavior.
rejected_routes.distribution_reason: Weak because the visuals could belong to any page.

selected_story_lens: Doing life together means choosing repeated ordinary rituals with the same person.
emotional_machine: gentle wish-list risk -> specific ordinary actions -> active shared participation -> soft playful proof that this is a life together
proof_engine: Mug, pen, tote, dish towel, dancing hands, sock, and path/doorway movement turn each line into visible behavior.
reader_mirror: People want the ordinary life with their person, not only the cinematic version.
distribution_reason: A viewer can send it to a partner as an exact confession of the small future they want.

human_story_setup.emotional_obstacle: Exact poetic text can feel borrowed unless the A Story version proves a new relationship scene.
human_story_setup.aachu_role: She is expressive and present through body language, hands, hair, and reactions.
human_story_setup.zuv_role: He actively participates in every ordinary ritual.
human_story_setup.proof_engine: Physical action and object movement carry the text.
human_story_setup.earned_payoff: The sock-toss ending makes the romance feel lived and human.

success_definition.audience_success: A cold viewer saves/sends it because they recognize ordinary future-love.
success_definition.creative_success: Every slide works as a staged scene before the text is read.
success_definition.brand_success: The deck feels like @a.storyof.two watercolor-and-ink intimacy, not a source screenshot clone.
success_definition.production_success: The route supports native 4:5 and separate 9:16 outputs with visual QA.
